items.raw_excerpt: A Jewish New Year celebration in Phuket was cancelled at the last minute on Friday evening because of concerns raised by Israeli security officials, organisers said.
items.summary_en: Organizers cancelled a Jewish New Year celebration in Phuket at the last minute on Friday evening. They said Israeli security officials raised concerns about the event. The celebration was called off before it could take place.
items.summary_ko: 조직 측은 금요일 저녁 마지막 순간에 푸켓의 유대인 새해 축제를 취소했다고 밝혔다. 이스라엘 보안 관계자들이 우려를 제기했기 때문이다. 축제는 시작되기 전에 무산됐다.
items.title_en: Phuket Jewish New Year event cancelled over security worries
items.title_ko: 푸켓 유대인 새해 축제, 보안 우려로 취소
items.title_original: Phuket Jewish New Year event cancelled on security grounds

items.raw_excerpt: Users in Singapore spent an estimated US$18.8 million on OnlyFans in the platform's most recent audited financial year, ranking 17th in the world for spending per adult.
items.summary_en: Users in Singapore spent about 18.8 million US dollars on OnlyFans in the latest financial year. This ranks 17th in the world for spending per adult.
